entries.title: Jeremiah 49:1
segments: Of the children of Ammon. Thus saith Jehovah: Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth Malcam possess Gad, and his people well in the cities thereof?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:2
segments: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon; and it shall become a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel possess them that did possess him, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:3
segments: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste; cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth: lament, and run to and fro among the fences; for Malcam shall go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:4
segments: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, [saying], Who shall come unto me?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:5
segments: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, from all that are round about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth, and there shall be none to gather together the fugitives.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:6
segments: But afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:7
segments: Of Edom. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:8
segments: Flee ye, turn back, dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I shall visit him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:9
segments: If grape-gatherers came to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, would they not destroy till they had enough?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:10
segments: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is destroyed, and his brethren, and his neighbors; and he is not.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:11
segments: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:12
segments: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, they to whom it pertained not to drink of the cup shall assuredly drink; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:13
segments: For I have sworn by myself, saith Jehovah, that Bozrah shall become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:14
segments: I have heard tidings from Jehovah, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, [saying], Gather yourselves together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:15
segments: For, behold, I have made thee small among the nations, and despised among men.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:16
segments: As for thy terribleness, the pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:17
segments: And Edom shall become an astonishment: every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:18
segments: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities thereof, saith Jehovah, no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man sojourn therein.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:19
segments: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoso is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd that will stand before me?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:20
segments: Therefore hear ye the counsel of Jehovah, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they shall drag them away, [even] the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:21
segments: The earth trembleth at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise whereof is heard in the Red Sea.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:22
segments: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah: and the heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:23
segments: Of Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad; for they have heard evil tidings, they are melted away: there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:24
segments: Damascus is waxed feeble, she turneth herself to flee, and trembling hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:25
segments: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:26
segments: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:27
segments: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:28
segments: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote. Thus saith Jehovah: Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:29
segments: Their tents and their flocks shall they take; they shall carry away for themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Terror on every side!

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:30
segments: Flee ye, wander far off, dwell in the depths, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith Jehovah; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:31
segments: Arise, get you up unto a nation that is at ease, that dwelleth without care, saith Jehovah; that have neither gates nor bars, that dwell alone.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:32
segments: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter unto all winds them that have the corners [of their hair] cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:33
segments: And Hazor shall be a dwelling-place of jackals, a desolation for ever: no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man sojourn therein.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:34
segments: The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:35
segments: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:36
segments: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:37
segments: And I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life; and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith Jehovah; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them;

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:38
segments: and I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence king and princes, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:39
segments: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring back the captivity of Elam, saith Jehovah.
